note: The public promotion listings at /promotion, /promotion/credit-card, /promotion/installment, /promotion/cash and /promotion/featured-promotions all return the same 220 tiles in plain HTML. Filters are client-side or form posts and are not used. Terms sit in section.promotionDetailConditionSection (anchor #condition) on the offer page. PDF and /getmedia/ paths are disallowed by robots.txt and are not fetched. /promotion/apply-card is not used as a start URL because the fetcher treats /apply in the path as an application form. The source_key is the last path segment of each offer URL (single_offer_page).
